instruments.budget_regime_provenance: RIA is a lump-sum instrument. CLAUDE.md §8.1 and the C1 amendment record contrast 'lump-sum instruments' (external Lump Sum Budget Planner) with 'unit-cost instruments (e.g. MSCA)'. The RIA application form carries the lump-sum declaration (Declaration 10, 'LUMP SUM GRANTS ONLY') and the D.x lump-sum budget breakdown. Source: af_he-ria-ia_en.pdf Part A pp.5-6, 15-16 of 24.
instruments.phases_in_scope_provenance: RIA runs the full canonical phase sequence (Phases 1-8): consortium/work-package-based drafting requiring call analysis, concept refinement, WP design, gantt/milestones, impact architecture, implementation architecture, budget gate, and drafting/review. Traceable to the manifest node_registry (n01-n08), all of which apply to a consortium RIA.
instruments.note: Instrument-level metadata for the profile resolver (runner/instrument_profile.py). The sub-section set and hard Part B page limit are read from section_schema_registry.json; this registry supplies budget_regime and phases_in_scope.
